- `post/getPopularPosts/GetPopularPosts.ts`
- `post/upvotePost/UpvotePost.ts`
- `post/createPost/CreatePost.ts`
- `post/downvotePost/DownvotePost.ts`
- `post/updatePostStats/UpdatePostStats.ts`

The other importer is `src/modules/forum/repos/implementations/sequelizePostRepo.ts`.
